transcript.text: AI agents will handle repetitive scaffolding—generating boilerplate, writing tests, refactoring—so devs can focus on system design, security trade‑offs, and aligning code with real user workflows. A practical test: give a model a spec for a microservice, let it produce the repo, then have a human audit architecture decisions and security boundaries; the model excels at the first pass, fails on nuanced threat modeling. That split lets teams ship faster while keeping critical judgment in human hands.

transcript.text: If AI drafts the entire repository, how do we verify that its generated dependency graph hasn't introduced supply‑chain risks before a human audit begins?

transcript.text: We can pipe the AI‑generated repo through an SBOM generator and a known vulnerability scanner before any human looks at it. transcript.text: Automated diff tests are useful but only surface functional changes; they won’t flag a backdoor that preserves the same API surface.
